def transform(grid):
    left=[row[:4] for row in grid]
    right=[row[5:9] for row in grid]
    # Keep left object when right-color mask is a subset of left-color mask; else overlay masks.
    leftmask={(r,c) for r in range(4) for c in range(4) if left[r][c]}
    rightmask={(r,c) for r in range(4) for c in range(4) if right[r][c]}
    if rightmask <= leftmask:
        return left
    return [[left[r][c] if left[r][c] else right[r][c] for c in range(4)] for r in range(4)]
